summary_md: **Jeet ([@Jeet0733](https://x.com/Jeet0733/status/2115704270322606180))** releases **Rapid-H3**, a ComfyUI node pack that runs MiniMax-H3 text/image-to-video+audio 3–5× faster on a single NVIDIA DGX Spark (about two minutes per 5-second clip) with no visible quality loss, crediting TensorFold's verify-everything approach ([jeet0733/Rapid-H3](https://github.com/jeet0733/Rapid-H3)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - jeet0733/Rapid-H3: Run MiniMax-H3 text/image to video+audio 3–5× faster on single NVIDIA DGX Spark: a ComfyUI node pack with INT8 sm_121 kernels and two ready presets (~2 min per clip), no visible quality loss.

relevance: Directly targets local video generation on Richard's DGX Spark.
